cli.intro: OpenWord — create, inspect and export documents on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create a document and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a document and print its committed revision and structure
cmd.save: Save an open document to a project file
cmd.inspect: Run structure and style checks on a document
cmd.edit: Apply atomic edits and print the new revision
cmd.export: Write one export target from a document

opt.title: Document title
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: styles, images, sections, tables, links
opt.format: Export target: docx, dotx, pdf, html or md
opt.paragraph: Append a paragraph with this text
opt.heading: Append a section heading with this text
opt.table: Append a table from a JSON array of string rows
opt.author: Document author
opt.expectedRevision: Reject the edit unless the document is at this revision
